source: saved original per-frame Native ego pose, original observed indicator state, and observed course-change event
area_class_source: independent original map/context review; not inferred from controller or weather
measurement: Sum horizontal Euclidean path steps from the last observed indicator onset through the single observed course-change frame. An off or opposite indicator sample resets the continuous interval.
weather_handling: Weather does not change the threshold. The saved weather source must be retained for independent review.
capture_requirement: Retain at least 30 seconds and enough approach to contain the entire 300-foot interval; reject left-censored signal onset.
limitations: A 20 Hz sample can establish continuity only at saved sample times; an intersample change is not observed.
A course-change flag must be independently checked against original pose, heading and lane observations.
The CPU fixture does not establish original Native movement, video visibility, area classification, statutory compliance or accepted recording coverage.
